classification: Independent source review and supplemental evidence; frozen formal grades unchanged
limits: No additional demonstrated contract defect was found in examined files and exercised paths; this does not prove every possible Starlette behavior.
Parameterized authored test counts are cases, not counts of independent behavioral guarantees.
Base-production collection errors reflect the absent feature, not 150 independently failing runtime tests.

source_checks.finding: A shared validator excludes booleans, negative integers and other types before reads. Request.body accumulates actual streamed bytes, rejects before caching a crossing chunk, and checks cached bodies without additional receive calls. Middleware buffers bounded HTTP scopes, catches only the buffer-size error, replays accepted bytes once, then delegates subsequent receives. The downstream app call remains outside the catch so endpoint errors propagate.
The public exception is an HTTPException with status 413, requested plain-text detail and limit/received attributes.

New regression files exercise low-level chunked streams, exact bounds, caches, malformed/lying Content-Length, repeated requests, exception preservation and the original TestClient fixtures. They pass as 150 parameterized cases. No existing tests/configuration changed.
